cephalad.definition:
adv. Forwards; towards the head or anterior extremity of the
   body; opposed to caudad.

cephalalgia.definition: n pain in the head caused by dilation of cerebral arteries or muscle contractions or a reaction to drugs

cephalalgic.definition:
a. Relating to, or affected with, headache.
n. A remedy for the headache.

n. A genus of fossil ganoid fishes found in the old red
   sandstone or Devonian formation. The head is large, and protected by a
   broad shield-shaped helmet prolonged behind into two lateral points.

cephalhematoma.definition: n. a collection of blood under the scalp of a newborn; caused by pressure during birth

a. 头的
[医] 头的, 头侧的

cephalin.translation:
n. 脑磷脂
[化] 脑磷脂

cephalization.definition:
n. Domination of the head in animal life as expressed
   in the physical structure; localization of important organs or parts in
   or near the head, in animal development.
cephalization.translation:
n. 头向集中
[医] 头部优势发育, 头部形成(无脊椎)

cephalo.definition:
A combining form denoting the head, of the head, connected
   with the head; as, cephalosome, cephalopod.

cephalocaudal axis.translation: [医] 头尾轴, 身体长轴

cephalochordate.translation:
n. 头索动物
a. 头索动物的

cephalochordates.definition:
plural of cephalochordate
n fish-like animals having a notochord rather than a true spinal column

cephalometry.translation: n. 头部测量法, 头部测量学

a. relating or belonging to the class Cephalopoda

cephalopodan.definition: a relating or belonging to the class Cephalopoda

a. relating or belonging to the class Cephalopoda

n. The anterior region or head of insects and other

cephalosporin.definition: n. one of several broad spectrum antibiotic substances obtained from fungi and related to penicillin (trade names Mefoxin); addition of side chains has produced semisynthetic antibiotics with greater antibacterial activity
cephalosporin.translation:
n. 头孢菌素
[医] 头孢子菌素

cephalosporins.definition:

[医] 头胸

n. An obstetrical instrument for performing

cephalotripsy.definition:

cephalous.definition:
